# Windows shell sandbox

Adapted from DeepSeek Harness commit `e8f7b93a344964de3dca1ace9e72b6e4d6de87cb`, packages `sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` and `subprocess/win32-process`, under the included MIT license. Actl uses the standalone ACL backend and inherited-stdio job path. Local adaptations connect Koffi directly and remove harness service dependencies.
